supercam.setting.zoom.tooltip: Hold the zoom key (C at first, in Controls) to look closer.
supercam.setting.zoom_amount.tooltip: How many times closer the zoom brings things when you press the key.
supercam.setting.zoom_scroll.tooltip: While the zoom key is held, the mouse wheel goes closer or further instead of changing your hotbar slot.
supercam.setting.zoom_keep_scroll.toolti: Starts the next zoom where your scrolling left the last one, instead of at Zoom Amount.
supercam.setting.zoom_smooth.tooltip: Eases in and out of the zoom instead of jumping.
supercam.setting.zoom_speed.tooltip: How quickly the smooth zoom settles, from 1 (slow) to 10 (quick).
supercam.setting.zoom_slow_mouse.tooltip: Turns the view more slowly the closer you zoom, so aiming stays steady.
supercam.setting.zoom_hide_hand.tooltip: Your hand and held item step out of view while zoomed.
supercam.setting.freecam.tooltip: The free camera key (F7 at first, in Controls) sends the camera out to fly on its own while you stay put. Press it again to come back.
supercam.setting.freecam_speed.tooltip: How fast the camera flies, in blocks a second. The mouse wheel changes it while the camera is out. Hold your sprint key to go faster.
supercam.setting.freecam_glide.tooltip: The camera speeds up and slows down gently instead of starting and stopping at once.
The camera flies through walls and the ground. Off, it stops at them.
supercam.setting.freecam_show_player.too: Shows your player where you left them while the camera is out.
supercam.setting.motion.tooltip: The view leans, dips, sways and shakes with what you do. Each part below has its own switch. The game's Distortion Effects setting also scales all of it.
supercam.setting.motion_third_person.too: Camera motion also works in third person, not only first person.
supercam.setting.motion_smoothness.toolt: How softly the lean and dip follow you, from 1 (snappy) to 10 (floaty).
supercam.setting.strafe_roll.tooltip: The view leans into sideways steps.
supercam.setting.strafe_roll_strength.to: How far the view leans when you step sideways.
supercam.setting.turn_roll.tooltip: The view banks a little into turns.
supercam.setting.turn_roll_strength.tool: How far the view banks when you turn.
supercam.setting.move_pitch.tooltip: The view tips forward as you speed up and back as you move backwards.
supercam.setting.move_pitch_strength.too: How far the view tips with your speed.
supercam.setting.air_pitch.tooltip: The view lifts as you jump and sinks as you fall.
supercam.setting.air_pitch_strength.tool: How far the view lifts and sinks.
supercam.setting.idle_sway.tooltip: After you stand still for a while, the view drifts very gently, like breathing.
supercam.setting.idle_sway_strength.tool: How far the idle sway drifts.
supercam.setting.idle_sway_delay.tooltip: Seconds of standing still before the sway starts.
supercam.setting.explosion_shake.tooltip: The view shakes when something blows up nearby; the closer, the harder.
supercam.setting.explosion_shake_strengt: How hard explosions and lightning shake the view.
supercam.setting.thunder_shake.tooltip: A nearby lightning strike shakes the view, and distant thunder gives a light rumble.
supercam.setting.walking_strength.toolti: How strong the lean, dip and tilt are on foot and in water.
supercam.setting.flying_strength.tooltip: How strong the lean, dip and tilt are while flying or gliding.
supercam.setting.riding_strength.tooltip: How strong the lean, dip and tilt are on a mount, in a boat or in a minecart.
supercam.setting.fov.tooltip: The game's field of view, in degrees: the same setting as FOV at the top of Options, saved with your options. Zoom works from whatever this is.
supercam.setting.breathing_hands.tooltip: While you stand idle, your hand and what it holds rise and settle slowly, as if you were breathing. Fades out as soon as you move, swing or use something. Some shader packs already do this; turn one of them off if the hands move twice.
supercam.setting.breathing_strength.tool: How far the hands rise and settle.
supercam.setting.breathing_speed.tooltip: How quickly you breathe, from 1 (slow, deep breaths) to 10 (quick ones).
supercam.setting.accent.tooltip: The colour of SuperCam's cards and highlights. Sunrise orange (#F9801D) by default.
